tests.name: Registry rejects missing, duplicate and circular dependencies with a useful path
Registry resolves each factory once and exposes a defensive graph copy
All production modules import without DOM side effects; dependency graph is acyclic
Stores and nested NPC, quiz and session data are isolated per game
Rules follow store replacement instead of retaining a stale state reference
Pre-refactor evaluation, dialogue and migration match 48 saved contracts exactly
NPC memory can be used independently of browser UI and is replayable
Save adapter preserves legacy key and full v8 decisions, memory and quiz on resume
Home knowledge preview cannot overwrite a pending resume checkpoint
Future saves lock writes even after a fresh state replaces the current one
Corrupt newest save falls back without erasing legacy data; storage errors are bounded
Assessment model is pure, follows behavior and does not turn ending A into learning credit
